method: Read actual merged source, compare prior candidate to adopted HEAD for non-SIM overlapping app and shell files, and compare the incoming base delta. Git reads used GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1. Reviewed app/shell files had no uncommitted diff at review time.
conclusions: No actionable non-SIM merge blocker found in the reviewed scope.
Snake still hides both demo entry actions for Team, Versus and community contexts; ordinary menu filtering and late demo action registration remain.
Snake native frame early-return ownership, transient demo pause and exact standard Ready Fresh path are preserved.
Solo owner-checked Hunt navigation context and localized reading prompts are presentation changes; guarded prepareDemoFresh and existing demo input/persistence gates remain unchanged.
Survival app overlap adds reroll disclosure copy backed by actual HTML; its scheduler, controller handoff, guarded Fresh and cancellation rollback remain unchanged.
Shared shell navigation context and aria-describedby changes preserve addHomeActions/controller ordering. Team native menu relocation is outside demo eligibility.
No changes to shared director, demo adapters or native demo corpus were present in the compared non-SIM scope.
limits: This is a bounded source review, not execution, browser, full coverage, or endurance qualification.
SIM changes and native SIM content identities are reviewed separately by the SIM agent.
Full runtime/build fingerprint was not recomputed by this review; file hashes identify only the listed source bytes.
Line anchors reflect the adopted source reviewed at c9101428f and may move after subsequent generated-file refreshes or integration.
